values.note: Online through Campspot or by phone. Daily-rate stays are paid in full at booking; cancel by noon seven days before arrival for a refund less C$20, later forfeits one night. A specific site can be locked for C$10. Monthly and seasonal stays need an approved long-term application. Check-in 3 pm, check-out 11 am.

sites.source: https://www.campspot.com/book/dinosaurrvpark (read 2026-11-10): one-night quote 2027-06-15 - Full Service (East Park) 57 sites 25-50 ft (9 pull-through), Full Service 50 Amp (East Park) 6 sites 40-70 ft, Full Service (West Park) 11 sites 30-40 ft, Power/Water (West Park) 7 sites 25 ft, Power/Water (East Park) 0 sites listed; plus one group RV site

note: RV park in Drumheller (500 North Dinosaur Trail), split between an East Park and a West Park, a short walk from the World's Largest Dinosaur, the aquaplex and downtown and a short drive from the Royal Tyrrell Museum; the Hoodoos and the Atlas Coal Mine are about 15 minutes away. Portable fire pits, an ATM, e-bike rentals and four rental cabins. From October 1 water to the sites may be shut off (fill-up stays available at the office). Monthly and seasonal sites are also sold. --Claude
